text:
olivia_fin: Heads-up — invoice INV-2026-079 from last cycle has a weird burst charge for BlueOak Labs. They say the spike happened during our cross-region failover window and they were on Dedicated (50k reserved tokens). Can ops confirm if this looks like duplicate metering?

matt_sales: Saw the customer note. They pointed at 2026-02-11 03:14-03:28 UTC where traffic rerouted. BlueOak claims traffic briefly hit both us-west and eu-west pools.

nina_cs: Customer reported latency >5s during failover and that the app retried a few thousand requests. They think retries caused the burst overage. Ticket #CS-9142 has their timeline.

harry_billing: Pulling the invoice lines now. The overage line is `DED-BURST 2026-02-11 03:00-04:00: +73k tokens` which pushed them ~$1,200 over commit. Invoice shows reserved commit applied, but burst meter still charged.

billing-bot: invoice INV-2026-079 generated for BlueOak Labs. Total due: $27,432. Overages: $1,200. Reserved commit: 50,000 tokens/month.

raj_sre: Quick check of metrics — we had a control plane failover at 03:12 UTC; routing re-registered some pods and KV caches were cold. I do see a short window where requests were duplicated for ~6 minutes due to race in the proxy failover path.

matt_sales: If requests were duplicated, that sounds platform-caused. Customer is asking for an SLA credit plus proration of next month's commit (they reduced seat count mid-cycle).

olivia_fin: Two actions needed: 1) confirm SRE that duplicate counting was our fault and estimate token delta attributable to platform. 2) Billing needs to prepare a credit memo draft and advise on proration for reduced commit.

harry_billing: I can draft a credit memo, but finance needs a clear justification and SRE token delta. Also need CS to confirm customer didn't intentionally re-run jobs.

nina_cs: BlueOak confirms they did no bulk replays — just standard client retries. I've attached their app logs in #attachments (link). They want the overage removed and a one-time goodwill credit for next invoice.

raj_sre: I ran a retrospective query: approx 48k tokens appear duplicated vs baseline during the 03:12–03:18 window. That's consistent with their reported overage. Root cause: proxy retry logic + simultaneous region registration. I'll open an incident and write a short postmortem.

zoe_vpfinance: For SLA credits we need the SLO breach quantification and a postmortem. If we confirm platform duplication caused >5% of customer's token usage that billing can apply an SLA credit. Do not auto-waive without SRE sign-off.

harry_billing: Understood. Assuming SRE confirms 48k duplicate tokens, the $1,200 overage would be reversed. For proration: customer reduced reserved commit from 50k -> 30k on 2026-02-20. We prorate the reserve for the remainder of the billing period (10 days). I can compute and apply a refund or credit. Which do we prefer?

matt_sales: Customer prefers a credit on the next invoice rather than a refund. Less churn.

olivia_fin: Notes for the memo: reference INV-2026-079, CS-9142, SRE-incident-2026-02-11, duplicated token delta ~48,000, estimated overage $1,200. Proposed resolution: reverse overage line, apply SLA credit equal to overage (pending postmortem), and apply prorated credit for commit reduction (credit on next invoice). Approve?

zoe_vpfinance: Approve conditional on SRE postmortem and Raj's final delta. Also require a short customer note explaining the fix and timeframe for permanent mitigation. Once SRE posts, Harry can issue the credit memo.

harry_billing: I'll hold the credit memo in draft and wait for SRE doc + CS confirmation. Action items: (1) Raj open postmortem and estimate exact token delta, (2) Nina confirm no intentional replays, (3) I'll prepare draft credit memo and proration calc.

raj_sre: Postmortem created: SRE-2026-02-11-duplicate-proxy. Final duplicate token count: 49,120. Root cause and remediation steps included.

nina_cs: Customer message: "Thanks — appreciate the quick investigation. Credit on next invoice is fine."

harry_billing: Drafted credit memo: CM-2026-014 referencing INV-2026-079. Lines: `Reverse overage: -$1,205.00 (49,120 tokens)`, `Prorated reserve reduction credit: -$850.00 (20k token difference * 10/28 prorate)` -> total credit -$2,055.00 applied to next invoice. Saving draft and will request final sign-off.

zoe_vpfinance: Looks reasonable. One request — include a short blurb that this credit is goodwill due to platform duplication; note we did not change baseline pricing. Include expected fix ETA.

harry_billing: Will add blurb and attach postmortem link. I'll file the credit memo tomorrow and mark the invoice as disputed until credit posts.

matt_sales: I'll follow up with BlueOak to confirm they see the credit on the next bill.

olivia_fin: Thanks team. Closing loop after credit posts. :white_check_mark:
